messages.content:
This is the transcript of a recorded stand-up SET. Units are: bit (a joke or bit he performs), crowd_work, banter (filler, transitions), intro (host/walk-on), outro, one numbered line each.
Split it into consecutive units. Each unit covers lines first..last (inclusive) and units must not overlap. A bit is ONE unit including its tags, act-outs and asides; start a new unit only when he moves to a different premise (watch for the turn: 'anyway', 'so', a new subject). intro = only the host introducing him / walk-on applause: his own first lines are material, even quick openers. outro = only his sign-off ('that's my time', socials). name = a short title for the unit (3-7 words). funny = true if it is comedic material.
